title: Address holistic repo review recommendations
description:
Holistic repo-health follow-up after the major Eshyra base has stabilized pre-1.0.

This epic collects architectural, release, persistence, and tooling hygiene recommendations from the repo-wide review. The goal is to address durable design risks now, while the project is still pre-1.0 and before these seams become expensive compatibility commitments.

Scope:
- Move SQLite schema management to a migration-first design.
- Enforce the public/internal package boundary between CLI and core.
- Harden release launcher portability.
- Add focused reliability guards around telemetry and tool registration.
- Strengthen schema-validator coverage for bundled tools.
- Clean stale documentation/comments after runtime and distribution changes.

Non-goals:
- Generic lint cleanup.
- Broad refactors unrelated to the reviewed risks.
- ORM adoption unless a child bead explicitly determines it is necessary.
close_reason: All child beads are complete and verified in this branch.
